questions.question: What is `songs[-1]`?
questions.explanation: Negative indexes count from the end: -1 is the last item.

questions.question: You need to look up a price by product name. Which structure fits best?
questions.explanation: A dict maps keys (product names) to values (prices), and lookups are instant: prices["apple"].

questions.question: What is `len({"a", "b", "a"})`?
questions.explanation: Sets keep only unique items, so the duplicate "a" disappears, leaving {"a", "b"}.

questions.question: How do you get a value from dict `ages` without an error if the key is missing?
questions.explanation: .get(key, default) returns the default when the key isn't there. ages["Bob"] would raise KeyError.
